target_customer: AI developers and companies running production retrieval and agent pipelines
problem: Production AI systems use expensive frontier LLMs for narrow steps like reranking and embedding, which is slow and costly, and retrieval accuracy is weak.
business_model: Usage-based API for rerankers and embeddings plus custom models and enterprise deployments
product_category: AI retrieval models and search infrastructure

founders.name: Ghita Houir Alami
education: Master's in applied mathematics, Ecole Polytechnique
Master's in applied mathematics, UC Berkeley
founders.background_notes: AI engineer and researcher in healthcare, finance, B2B SaaS and consumer AI per YC.

founders.name: Nicholas Pipitone
founders.background_notes: CTO or lead developer at five startups, low-level C/C++ and GPU code per YC.

technical_complexity.rationale: Training state of the art rerankers and embeddings that beat incumbents needs ML research, data and GPU engineering, which the team claimed in benchmarks.

defensibility.rationale: Model quality was a real edge on vendor benchmarks, but rerankers are commoditised by Cohere, Voyage, Jina and open models, so the edge needed constant retraining.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Notion acquired the team in July 2026, open sourced the models under Apache 2.0 and sunset the products by 4 September 2026.

market_need_then: RAG and agent builders needed better retrieval quality and lower latency than general LLMs gave. The company reported customers such as Assembled, Profound, Sendbird and Mem0.

branding.name_origin: The YC page says entropy in information retrieval is the expected variability of information, so zero entropy implies knowing exactly what a message contains.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, engineer focused and declarative, lowercase model names such as zerank-2 and zembed-1

branding.community_and_virality: Open sourced rerankers on Hugging Face and an extensive technical blog with comparison articles.

brand_strength.rationale: A technical name with a clear meaning among ML engineers and a model naming system, a respected seed round and open source distribution, though not a household name.

pivots.from: AI search engine for complex documents
pivots.to: Task specific rerankers, embeddings and custom models
pivots.why: Not stated; YC page notes the earlier launch post described a search engine and the company now describes specialised models.

outcome_analysis: ZeroEntropy raised a 4.2M seed in July 2025 after YC Winter 2025, shipped open competitive rerankers and embeddings with named customers, and was acquired by Notion in July 2026 with the team forming a model research group. It reads as a technical team led acquisition where quality models beat incumbents on benchmarks. Price is undisclosed.
notes: Seed amount confirmed by TechCrunch (headline and search listing) and the company's own post, which also says total about 4.4M; another aggregator says 4.5M and one company page title said 4.1M. Entrepreneurs First pre-seeded earlier, amount not found. A 2026-08 date appears on one aggregator; the company and Notion posts support July 2026. Competitor search returned mostly 2026 pages so no dated as-of-founding competitor is listed, though Cohere, Voyage and Jina rerankers are named in later sources.
